verdict.rationale: No documentation in the evidence pack describes a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting for Postman, and community reports indicate the opposite — users note Postman 'needs to be online in order to send telemetry' and that it uploads secrets/environment data without an apparent way to disable this (postman-comm-11, postman-comm-12, postman-comm-6). No first-party privacy/opt-out control is documented anywhere in the pack.
